args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), which is unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Attempted to roll back to the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.0), but the rollback tool returned 503 Service Unavailable after multiple retries and the rollback was NOT executed. Manual intervention is required to roll back checkout-api to v2.3.0.

trace.final:
I attempted to roll back checkout-api but was unable to complete the rollback. Here's what happened:

**Diagnosis:**
- checkout-api is currently on `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent healthy production release is `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 is the failing deploy).

**Actions taken:**
1. Attempted to roll back to `v2.3.0` — the rollback tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` and was **NOT executed**, despite multiple retries (the tool itself performed backoff retries internally).
2. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) for checkout-api describing the situation and paging on-call.

**Outstanding issue requiring manual intervention:**
The rollback could not be completed because the rollback tool is persistently unavailable (503). checkout-api remains on the unhealthy `v2.3.1` in all regions. An on-call engineer has been paged via the incident and will need to manually roll back to `v2.3.0` (or restore the rollback tool) to restore service health.
